scripts.check: node tools/ont-check/ont-check.mjs --config ont.config.json && node tools/ont-check/ont-check.mjs --config example/ont.config.json && node tools/ont-check/ont-check.mjs --config templates/ont.config.json
scripts.generate: node tools/ont-check/gen-contracts.mjs --config ont.config.json && for c in example templates; do node tools/ont-check/gen-glossary.mjs --config $c/ont.config.json && node tools/ont-check/gen-contracts.mjs --config $c/ont.config.json && node tools/ont-check/gen-reference.mjs --config $c/ont.config.json || exit 1; done
